name: Enrich Emails
runs_on: Table People (implied), any View by name; fired once by Enrich Contacts on Not Waterfalled
reads: Email (the candidate list), first_name, last_name, Domain, LinkedIn URL; the base's own proof at the same domains (Status = done rows: their Final Email gives the address shape, Email Verified By BounceBan marks the domain catch-all)
creates: Final Email, Email Provider (single select, a new provider mints its own choice), Email Verified By (MillionVerifier, BounceBan), Email Verified At, Email Candidates; Status is a requirement
held_value: a worked row is rewritten: Email becomes the full candidate list, the lane fields are set from the verdict
providers: MillionVerifier (verifier of record; out of credits stops the run), Blitz email by LinkedIn URL, LeadMagic (last, paid)
logs: the launch row, accumulated per batch of 100: per provider, guesses, catch-all domains, coverage
handoff: Verify Catch-alls, once, on the whole People table (rows with Status = verifying)
